fields.Name: SourcedFrom
fields.Description: Connects a synthesized or curated GraphConcept to a supporting ContentItemChunk or document.

fields.Name: Mentions
fields.Description: Connects a ContentItemChunk or document to a GraphConcept or entity record mentioned within its text.

fields.Name: BroaderThan
fields.Description: Connects a parent or umbrella concept to a more specific child concept.

fields.Name: NarrowerThan
fields.Description: Retired: the inverse label of BroaderThan, not a type of its own. Store a BroaderThan edge from the broader concept to the narrower one instead. The row stays so edges stored under it before it was retired still read; the "Graph Edges: Retype NarrowerThan as BroaderThan" Record Process converts them.

fields.Name: Defines
fields.Description: Connects an Alternate Base View or Query to the Graph Concept it formally defines. Direction is artifact to concept: the source is the view or query, the target is the concept.

fields.Name: Describes
fields.Description: Connects an Entity or Entity Field to the Graph Concept whose data it holds. Direction is artifact to concept: the source is the entity or field, the target is the concept.

fields.Name: Measures
fields.Description: Connects a Query or Alternate Base View to the metric Graph Concept it computes. Direction is artifact to concept: the source is the query or view, the target is the concept.

fields.Name: Implements
fields.Description: Connects an Action, AI Skill or AI Agent to the process or policy Graph Concept it implements. Direction is artifact to concept: the source is the action, skill or agent, the target is the concept.

fields.Name: Governs
fields.Description: Connects a Policy or Steward Role concept to the Process, Domain, or Entity it governs.

fields.Name: DependsOn
fields.Description: Connects a concept, metric, or workflow to another concept it depends upon.

fields.Name: Contradicts
fields.Description: Flags a discrepancy or conflicting numeric/policy threshold between two chunks or concepts for steward review.

fields.Name: Supersedes
fields.Description: Indicates that a newer or higher-authority concept or policy supersedes an older one.

fields.Name: RelatedTo
fields.Description: General symmetric association between two concepts or records.

fields.Name: LinksTo
fields.Description: A document links to another record by name (a [[Name]] reference in its text). Recorded as an MJ: Record Links row by the artifact graph indexer and projected by the Record Link edge provider.

fields.Name: SharesConceptWith
fields.Description: Two documents (or other records indexed by the Content Pipeline) were each a source of the same graph concept. Derived on read by the Shared Concept edge provider; never stored.

fields.Name: Subsets
fields.Description: Connects an Alternate Base View to the entity whose rows it is a subset of. Derived on read by the Alternate Base View edge provider; never stored.

fields.Name: Is A
fields.Description: Connects an IS-A child entity to its parent entity. Derived on read by the Entity Metadata edge provider; never stored.

fields.Name: References
fields.Description: Connects an entity to an entity it holds a foreign key to (the description names the field). Derived on read by the Entity Metadata and Foreign Key edge providers; never stored.

fields.Name: Reads
fields.Description: Connects a Query to an entity or Alternate Base View it selects from. Derived on read by the Query Metadata edge provider; never stored.

fields.Name: Composes
fields.Description: Connects a Query to a query it composes through {{query:"..."}}. Derived on read by the Query Metadata edge provider; never stored.

fields.Name: Field Of
fields.Description: Connects an Entity Field to the entity it belongs to. Derived on read by the Entity Metadata edge provider; never stored.

fields.Name: Preferred Over
fields.Description: Says to use the source instead of the target: the target is a deprecated or lower-authority equivalent of the source.

fields.Name: Same As
fields.Description: General symmetric equivalence between two nodes that name the same thing.
